name: ngo-grant-deadline-watch
title: NGO Grant Deadline Watch
description: Monitor grants.gov and foundation grant pages for new funding opportunities - every grant deadline detected with amount, eligibility and close date, so NGO teams never miss a submission.

input.title: Input schema for Pry NGO Grant Deadline Watch
input.description: Monitor grants.gov and foundation grant pages for new funding opportunities - every grant deadline detected with amount, eligibility and close date, so NGO teams never miss a submission.

change_threshold.title: Change threshold
change_threshold.description: SimHash bit distance above this counts as changed (0 = any difference, 3 default, 10+ only major rewrites).

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

eligibility_filter.title: Eligibility filter
eligibility_filter.description: Only emit grants matching these eligibility keywords.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
